task_title: peak Torch allocated/reserved, CUDA 전체 process memory(가용한 계측 사용), RSS/PSS 또는 플랫폼 동등량, committed memory, OS cache, 디스크 사용량·총 읽기/쓰기·실효 대역폭을 구분한다

physics_configuration.module: tests/test_memory_accounting_g5.py with the scatterer of tests/g5_support.py (24 x 16 x 16 cells, 40 steps, two point probes, full time history)
physics_configuration.runs: StreamedSimulation forward and backward with host_sync, disk_sync and host_async CUDA tiles (slab_width 6, temporal_depth 4, checkpoints 2), one CPU-tile run with host banks, and two MemoryMeter phases around explicit CUDA allocations
physics_configuration.instrument_module: torchfdtd/memory_accounting.py: MemoryMeter around each phase of torchfdtd/streamed.py::_Streamed (report['forward_memory'], report['backward_memory'])

fields.peak_torch_allocated_bytes: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated (exact when the phase set a new process peak or began at it, otherwise the sampled torch.cuda.memory_allocated lower bound, flagged exact=false); at_start_bytes, delta_bytes, prior_process_peak_bytes
fields.peak_torch_reserved_bytes: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved with the same exactness rule
fields.cuda_process_memory_bytes: torch.cuda.mem_get_info free-memory decrease during the phase, device-wide, sampled every 20 ms and at the end; nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps used_memory for this pid when the driver exposes it (N/A under WDDM on Windows, reported as null with the reason)
fields.peak_process_rss_bytes: working set from psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo (Windows) or /proc/self/status VmRSS (Linux), sampled every 20 ms and at the phase boundaries, with the OS lifetime peak
fields.peak_process_committed_bytes: PagefileUsage commit charge (Windows) or VmSize (Linux, labelled virtual size)
fields.os_file_cache_bytes: psapi.GetPerformanceInfo SystemCache times PageSize (Windows) or /proc/meminfo Cached (Linux): change over the phase, system-wide
fields.scratch_disk_written_bytes, scratch_disk: StateStore logical byte counters of the scratch bank files plus the process I/O counter deltas (GetProcessIoCounters or /proc/self/io)
fields.scratch_disk_bandwidth_bytes_per_second: logical scratch bytes divided by the phase wall time
fields.scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes: peak sum of live scratch bank file sizes; every bank file is truncated to its size and the size is read back with os.fstat
fields.host_bank_bytes: SlabBlockOperator bank ledger: peak and created bytes of live host field banks released through weak references

physics_configuration.caveats_written_into_every_record: each field carries instrument, caveat and domain (device, host, system, disk); total_memory_bytes is null with a note that the fields overlap; the SCOPE text states which fields contain which

reference_method: internal consistency of the instruments: the Torch allocator's own counters, the OS process counters and the StateStore file sizes read back with os.fstat; no physics oracle is involved

observables.name: scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes
observables.definition: peak live bank file bytes, per phase

observables.name: host_bank_bytes
observables.definition: peak live host bank bytes, per phase

acceptance_limits.presence: every field listed above is present in both phase records with domain, instrument and caveat; total_memory_bytes is null; the record is JSON-serializable
acceptance_limits.ordering: 0 < peak_torch_allocated_bytes <= peak_torch_reserved_bytes and allocated at_start <= reserved at_start in every CUDA phase; the delta of the allocated peak is positive; the allocator peaks are exact when the test resets the peak counters first
acceptance_limits.domains: peak_process_rss_bytes has domain host, its caveat says it is not device memory, its instrument does not name torch.cuda, and its value differs from the Torch allocated peak; CPU-tile runs report the three device fields as null with a not-applicable instrument and still report the host fields
acceptance_limits.disk: for the disk-bank run, in each phase created_file_bytes == created_banks * state_bytes, scratch_disk_written_bytes and scratch_disk_read_bytes equal the StateStore counters, scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes is an integer multiple of state_bytes between 1 and state_bank_capacity, host_bank_bytes is zero, the effective rates equal bytes / seconds; in the forward phase written bytes equal created_file_bytes exactly (every owned row of every bank committed once) and in the backward phase written bytes are at least created_file_bytes
acceptance_limits.host_banks: for host-bank runs host_bank_bytes is a positive multiple of state_bytes and the scratch bytes are zero
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: G5-02 specification: the quantities are separated and never summed; equalities are exact byte counts and no numeric tolerance applies

applicable_scope: Windows 11 with the RTX 3060 under WDDM (nvidia-smi per-process memory reported as N/A) and CPU tiles: the streamed report's per-phase memory fields for host, disk and asynchronous CUDA tiles; Linux instruments (/proc) and TCC/Linux nvidia-smi are implemented but not exercised here re-recorded on 6d03e49d91d4 for the release candidate.
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
